newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Television Azteca Q1 net profit soars.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Television Azteca Q1 net profit soars.

text.p: Television Azteca, Mexico's second largest broadcaster, said Wednesday its first quarter net profit was 301.1 million pesos, up 48 percent over the 202.86 million peso net posted in the same period a year earlier.
The privately-held company said net revenues for the first quarter rose 139 percent to 685.23 million pesos from 286.4 million pesos in the same period in 1996.
In a statement published in national media, Azteca said the increased sales for the quarter reflected its growing share of the Mexican TV-watching audience.
Azteca said its weekday prime-time audience share increased to 36 percent in the first quarter from 20 percent in the first quarter of 1996.
"The company's share of the audience from 0600 to midnight seven days a week increased to 27 percent in the first quarter of 1997 from 16 percent in the first quarter of 1996," it added.
